The Atlas Logistics pilot exceeded all predefined success benchmarks, as detailed in its measured result table [NL-020-S04]. Specifically, actual results surpassed targets across six metrics: Weekly Active Usage reached 87.5% (target >75%), Query Success Rate reached 84.2% (target >80%), Citation Accuracy reached 88.6% (target >85%), Median Onboarding Duration was reduced to 4.8 weeks (target 5.0 weeks), Support Escalation Decline hit 18.4% (target >15%), and Average Query Latency was 1.8 seconds (target <2.0 sec) [NL-020-S04].

The pilot yielded key lessons for refining the implementation playbook: document preparation must be made a mandatory pre-ingestion phase to prevent citation errors, permissions should be kept simple with broad department-level workspaces rather than complex nested folders, and frontline teams require mobile-friendly UI designs and messaging integrations to drive adoption [NL-020-S07]. Lina Park recommends a standard 5-step readiness checklist for all mid-market implementations, covering ingestion queue audits, permissions mapping, frontline hardware checks, supervisor training webinars, and CSAT feedback loops [NL-020-S07].

Based on these measured results and lessons, the Customer Success team recommends a phased full company-wide rollout [NL-020-S08]. Phase 1 (Q3 2026) expands the Growth Plan deployment from 80 to 500 users across regional offices in Chicago, Dallas, and Atlanta, with a $2,500 onboarding fee and training webinars led by Lina Park [NL-020-S08]. Phase 2 (August 2026) transitions Atlas to the advanced OCR ingestion pipeline for legacy scanned documents [NL-020-S08]. Phase 3 (Q4 2026) assesses transitioning to the Enterprise Plan if user count exceeds the 2,000 learner limit—such as adding 1,500 delivery drivers—which would also deploy the Microsoft Teams integration for mobile access [NL-020-S08]. Phase 4 (Q1 2027) involves establishing an automated data pipeline via REST API for weekly synchronization, alongside an automated query audit script to ensure citation accuracy, with quarterly performance reports presented by CSM Jordan Lee [NL-020-S08].
